title: Hush
summary: What must a RESP-compatible server make explicit about memory and concurrency?
context: A compact implementation for investigating protocol, expiration, queues, and memory policies.
constraints: TTL and eviction need predictable semantics.

decisions.title: Bounded state
decisions.body: LRU and TTL make eviction and expiration part of behavior.

decisions.title: Protocol before product
decisions.body: RESP defines the boundary; persistence and clustering are not implied.

evidence.label: Public code
evidence.detail: RESP, LRU, TTL, queues, and concurrency implemented.

limits: A laboratory, not a production Redis replacement.
